text:
Rae (Support): Customer 'DocStream' opened a P1 asking for streamed completions that emit incremental function-call events to their webhook and a final reconciled JSON. They want downstream work to start on partials.

Ivy (Sales): Customer numbers: bursts ~380 qps, steady ~40 rps. They ask for <250ms per chunk and a beta SLA to close the deal.

Noel (Product): Quick clarifiers: webhook only? resumable resume_token? server-side schema validation + final reconcile event?

Rae (Support): Webhook preferred (HTTP POST events). They require resume_token to resume after disconnect and server-side schema validation. A final "final_output" event is required.

Sam (Eng): Tech notes: we stream tokens + final fncall today. To add partial fncall events we need explicit event framing (fncall.start, fncall.update, fncall.finish), resume tokens at checkpoints, and idempotency keys. Rough estimate: 2w spec + 3-5w build + 1w SDK/docs + canary. Main risks: replay duplication, ordering on reconnect, webhook backpressure.

Kai (SRE): Webhook delivery needs retries/backoff, idempotency, DLQ, and per-request tracing for billing.

Noel (Product): Proposed beta acceptance criteria: 1) deterministic fncall events (start/update/finish) to webhook; 2) resume token & idempotent replay; 3) final validated JSON with explicit error codes; 4) Python/TS SDK helpers; 5) signed webhook + optional PII redaction hook.

Ivy (Sales): DocStream wants beta in 6 weeks. Can we commit to webhook-only beta in 6?

Sam (Eng): Webhook-only beta is possible in 6 weeks if we limit to one model family and skip on-prem. Full rollout ~10-12 weeks. PII redaction adds ~3 business days.

ops-bot: Created backlog ticket INF-6001 and assigned to Sam.

Noel (Product): I'll mark P0 and write acceptance criteria linked to INF-6001. Sam to draft RFC with event schema and resume semantics.

Sample event sketch Sam pasted:
POST /webhooks/docstream
Headers: { "X-Redwood-Event": "fncall.update", "X-Req-Id": "rq_42" }
Body: { "request_id": "rq_42", "call_id": "c_9", "event": "fncall.update", "delta": {"path":"items[2]","op":"append","value":{...}}, "resume_token": "rt_9" }

Rae (Support): I'll confirm canary willingness and whether redaction must be inline or can be async.

Ivy (Sales): Thanks team, I'll update DocStream with the beta plan. :thumbsup:
